contract: Native matching, navigation, source/causal guards, selective replacement and exact recovery stay in Rust; JavaScript only presents admitted metadata and submits named intentions.
Original command unions, startup defaults, checkpoint tags, schemas and journal meanings remain unchanged.
Borrowed controls own transient reads, drafts, subscriptions and out-of-tree paint; they never create, close or discard an editor or durable writer.

Queued search work retains its opaque read and original revision; replacement data is detached. Changed composition/source, policy revocation, disposal and queue exhaustion reject rather than recompute.
Managed shared search startup is separately named, requires explicit grammar/history/scope and restores only its declared family. Old durable keys are not auto-migrated.
Closed panels retain drafts; React rerenders retain owners and StrictMode/retirement preserve failed-close recovery and writer leases.
The 8192-rectangle viewport paint ceiling is presentation only with an explicit clipping notice. Native results and atomic Replace All remain complete under their separate unchanged limits.
Read-only owners can navigate without history; replacement requires current write policy and shared search recovery opt-in.
repairs: Added local/shared DOM queue completion and readonly notifications without JSON-detaching opaque results or widening old execute contracts.
Reused managed vanilla/React retirement/recovery lanes through separately named search factories and immutable startup policy.
Seeded independent offline consumer locking and verified exact registry identities to prevent transitive resolution drift beyond the producer lock.
Updated the installed application export expectation for the additive opaque SharedSearchResults class.
Resolved the screenshot fixture image explicitly; screenshot capture follows successful browser workflows and loaded assets.

retainedDevelopmentAttempts.result: Initial lockless install selected uncached undici 7.30.0 instead of producer-locked 7.29.1 and failed ENOTCACHED. Repaired the consumer test lock, not dependency versions or network policy.
Two existing mocks omitted new named startup exports. Added explicit mocks and positive lifecycle tests without deleting old assertions; final 39 files/376 tests pass.

The initial oracle required PEERDONE as one adjacent serialized substring after tombstones/Undo/Redo. The corrected check reads actual text runs and preserves native-admitted placement, replaces MATCH with DONE, and checks peer text/convergence after every Undo. Native causal/history policy did not change.

Intermediate generic-wrapper type errors, a browser-check parenthesis error and qualification-generator shell quoting were repaired. Their tool outputs are not separately archived test logs; the generator correction changes no qualified source.
